summary.text: Terri O'Rorke is a Democratic state representative from Cheshire District 7 in the New Hampshire House of Representatives, where she has served since December 2024, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Terri O'Rorke assumed office in the New Hampshire House of Representatives on December 4, 2024, succeeding Shaun Filiault, an independent.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on September 8, 2026, and is on the November 3 ballot for Cheshire 7, where Jonathan Liptak is also a candidate.
